name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: What policies are you hoping to see passed?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This momentum can translate to real policy changes.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2297%2E4032634%2E8vNivn)
---
Democrats are riding a strong wave of momentum heading into November — chipping in to support candidates up and down the ticket, signing up to volunteer, and talking to their friends and family about this race. That momentum that can translate to electing Kamala Harris to be president, defending our Senate Majority, taking back the House, and then passing transformative policies for working families across the country in 2025. Policies that will ensure the right to an abortion federally. Make child care and health care actually affordable. Make the ultra-rich pay their fair share in taxes. Fight climate change. Root corruption out of Washington. And so much more. Policies that critics continue to say are too unrealistic, too pie-in-the-sky, to difficult to tackle — they’re all within our reach. **As we enter the final stretch of this election, I want to hear about the policies and issues that are close to your heart, and that you are eager to see passed. Let’s think of it as the polar opposite of Project 2025.** [**What are the top issues on your mind right now? Fill in this quick survey to let me and my team know — it should only take a couple of minutes, and I’d be grateful to hear what policies you want Democrats to prioritize in 2025.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/wfs-ak-em-issues-survey-aug/?refcode=EMZ21Y_SUR_E_20240802_V1S1&t=8&akid=2297%2E4032634%2E8vNivn) I’m fired up — and I want to know what you’re fired up about, too. That is why Judicial Watch filed a Federal Communications Commission (FCC) complaint against NBC for airing obscene and indecent content from the Olympics Opening Ceremony. The blasphemous Olympics’ Opening Ceremony that included, among other obscene and indecent acts, a man partially exposing himself around children, is patently offensive for any sensible American and requires immediate FCC action against NBC. Our FCC complaint reads in part: NBC and its various stations/outlets on TV, cable and Internet carried (and continues to make available) the Olympics Opening Ceremony on July 26, which included an adult male purposefully exposing (himself) in the presence of a child/children. This content is both obscene and indecent and, to make matters worse, was aired during viewing hours when it was likely seen by millions of children and minors. The obscene/indecent content occurred during a portion of the ceremonies that mocked Jesus Christ and the Last Supper. The Olympics was forced to issue an apology over the content. According to the FCC [], “federal law prohibits obscene, indecent and profane content from being broadcast on the radio or TV.” The FCC further states: Obscene content does not have protection by the First Amendment. For content to be ruled obscene, it must meet a three-pronged test established by the Supreme Court: It must appeal to an average person’s prurient interest; depict or describe sexual conduct in a “patently offensive” way; and, taken as a whole, lack serious literary, artistic, political or scientific value. Indecent content portrays sexual or excretory organs or activities in a way that is patently offensive but does not meet the three-prong test for obscenity. Profane content includes “grossly offensive” language that is considered a public nuisance. The FCC notes airing obscene or indecent content is a federal crime: It is a violation of federal law to air obscene programming at any time. It is also a violation of federal law to broadcast indecent or profane programming during certain hours. Under 18 U.S.C. Section 1464, “[w]hoever utters any obscene, indecent, or profane language by means of radio communication shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than two years, or both.” Under 18 U.S.C. Section 1468(a), “[w]hoever knowingly utters any obscene language or distributes any obscene matter by means of cable television or subscription services on television, shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than 2 years or by a fine in accordance with this title, or both.” Likewise, under 47 U.S.C. Section 559, “[w]hoever transmits over any cable system any matter which is obscene or otherwise unprotected by the Constitution of the United States shall be fined under Title 18 or imprisoned not more than 2 years, or both.” Section 73.3999 of the Commission’s rules, applicable to broadcast stations, bans the broadcast of obscene material and prohibits radio and television broadcasts of indecent material between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m. The Justice Department should also launch an investigation, especially given the use of children in this obscene and indecent NBC broadcast. Any person can file a complaint about the NBC broadcast directly with the FCC: . AS AG KAMALA HARRIS HELPED MAN BECOME NATION’S FIRST UNDOCUMENTED LAWYER Kamala Harris’ outrageous support for illegal aliens goes way back to her days in California state office. Our Corruption Chronicles blog has the details []. Years before her catastrophic failure as the Biden administration’s border czar, Vice President Kamala Harris helped an illegal alien become the nation’s first undocumented lawyer while she was California’s top law enforcement official. In a court brief filed during the illegal alien’s years-long legal battle to obtain a law license, then California Attorney General Harris wrote that “it is not a crime either to be present or to work in the United States without immigration status.” Even the Obama administration opposed an illegal immigrant practicing law in the United States and the Department of Justice (DOJ) challenged it, arguing that a 1996 immigration reform law precludes undocumented aliens from receiving commercial and professional licenses issued by states and the federal government. Accordingly, the California Supreme Court blocked the illegal immigrant’s license to practice law and the case went on for years until Harris intervened on the migrant’s behalf. Though it occurred over a decade ago, the story resurfaced this week as part of the mainstream media’s love fest with Harris since she replaced Joe Biden as the Democratic candidate for president. A Sacramento newspaper published a celebratory puff piece [] in which the illegal immigrant attorney, Sergio Covarrubias-Garcia, praises Harris for intervening to help him become a lawyer despite living in the U.S. illegally and being sentenced for reentering the country after being deported. Garcia was born in the Mexican state of Michoacán and first came to the U.S. illegally as an infant but lived in both Mexico and the U.S. until permanently moving to northern California at the age of 17. A court document [] [ by Judicial Watch shows that he was convicted and sentenced after “pleading guilty to being an alien found unlawfully in the United States after previously having been removed.” Garcia graduated from a public high school in a northern California farming town and reportedly earned scholarships to “prestigious universities,” but could not accept them “due to his status as an undocumented immigrant,” according to a biography [] published by a public university where he delivered an inspirational lecture. He enrolled at Butte Community College near his home and completed his undergraduate degree at the publicly-funded California State University Chico before graduating from Cal Northern School of Law, a private school in Chico. Garcia passed the California State Bar exam in 2009 but was prohibited from practicing law because he was an illegal immigrant. His case received a lot of media attention with open border groups and many of the state’s Latino legislators supporting him. The feds, on the other hand, rightfully litigated to stop the illegal alien from practicing law in the country. Then Harris came to the rescue. She submitted a written brief to the court supporting Garcia’s case and provided a taxpayer-funded lawyer from the attorney general’s office to argue for him in front of the California Supreme Court, according to the recently published news story. Contradicting the Obama DOJ, Harris’s court brief said a license for Garcia would comply with state and federal policies that “encourage immigrants, both documented and undocumented, to contribute to society.” The legal filing continues to claim that “it is not a crime either to be present or to work in the United States without immigration status, and Garcia has never been charged with the crime of unlawful entry. In fact, Garcia has been forthright about his immigration status with federal officials and has been approved for a visa when one becomes available.” Keep in mind, this is our border czar. Garcia, who is 47 years old, is of course “fully backing Harris on her campaign to become the first female president of the United States” and is eternally grateful to the former California Attorney General. “To know that the ‘top cop’ in California did not hate me for being undocumented and was supporting me and wanting me to achieve my dream, that was huge,” Garcia says in the article. One of the attorneys who represented Garcia and is currently the dean of the University of California Davis Law School confirms that Harris’s endorsement “made the difference” in the case and eventually led to Garcia obtaining his law license. “When the highest law enforcement officer of a state weighs in and says this is legal, this is permissible, this is possible, the Supreme Court of the State of California listens,” said the UC Davis Law Dean, Kevin Johnson. “She could have ducked and covered and tried to avoid any political controversy.” Harris took it a step further and even awarded the nation’s first illegal immigrant to practice law with a medal of valor. I never imagined I would be saying this:
| | |
---
Hi friend, can I tell you a quick story about this photo?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90115555/489495399/-1984759417?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1636-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2Y0YzgwNjUtMzQ1MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=vxlXodWtzRPI-h-HuRXOZavE6ZuritA4FwIiAZu-cbw=)
That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh off a student research assistant job for Professor Laurence Tribe, thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic career. Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few weeks away.)
Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.
As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that.
Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country...
...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...
...serve on the January 6 Committee...
...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above...
...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president.
Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it.
In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

name: Hillsdale College via ICYMI News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqfs76f7pgvqj54vbugo9jsuqpn0i8de54007alo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cdjm9oj2clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zv2pehtktd9d0681u2i5kdnh2v1jfu7psnios6eg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cdjm9oj2clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmorjk3ct42vp3s6s7qd57vv1t0dfb4nijkue2hg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cdjm9oj2clh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsbsel4i8ef20g0pbhs7r4dqd8r7qoh4c18pf6r8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cdge8o32cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlco1f7j85hs9hahndq77ef1svqdr9jllo72f0u0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cdge8o32cjh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znbg3ga37o4er40f35qpujfdc2slvvsflcinii38_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cdge8o32cjh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp1hhh5pj13jhl2ij3ambl99nnjd6sqgd80vhhs8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cdge8o32cjh2bs)**

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. I'll never forget the day I borrowed my mother's fur coat to go undercover as a prostitute.

And we nearly pulled off the unthinkable in that race.

Since then, my life has taken a turn. I'm now running for Congress in one of the most closely watched races in the country. Many folks are saying whatever happens here will determine who controls the House Majority this time next year.

## Chevron Moving to Houston
Chevron is [relocating its headquarters from California to Houston](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQQNGvMR3IDMawhYvX0O1rU6KxPSyjGLyxvUD-PsrW6a90pPtxn-_IgffHf9zIlGuJM7rCB81j3dWgZlV5Y6W_tRWZdgDQ4zBAW63GW6k6Uk6jlkDQj1L3CL2VFlrZe6zYgAQlR9m1stedatyISF7DiM5ZNdyEkuS5xNSUlQpdmJfwHQ9KjYtbFcxayjOL7p-AScB0nmezxMu-Mu-U828jYNowfVLJAia30pHiXicK0WHh_VE7DLzEtDPWK6H_emEqlHL9tqpk_PPkEDjrQSj52JDDWy5_fzgM_AQAAP__cWJjVw) in response to growing oil and gas regulations in the Golden State. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Why The Left Hates Israel – update from Mississippi’s conservative think tank
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11572901?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,
**On October 7 last year, ordinary civilians in Israel were the victims of extraordinary savagery.** Hamas terrorists killed young people at a music festival, often in gruesome ways. Families were slaughtered in suburban homes. By any civilized moral standards, there ought to be overwhelming sympathy for a country subjected to such savagery.
---
|
---
_Aftermath of Hamas terror attacks_
| Instead, throughout the Western world, we have witnessed endless anti- Israel protests. Why?

Part of the reason is demographics. **In Britain, for example, in 2001 there were one and half million Muslims. Today, there are almost four million. **

That is not to say that every — or even most — British Muslims are anti- Israel. But it does explain the scale and size of some recent protests.

So, too, on American university campuses. There have been frequent anti-Israel student protests, often at so-called elite universities. It is perhaps not a coincidence that there has also been a rapid rise in the number of students with Middle Eastern backgrounds at such universities.
---
|
---
_Anti-Israel protesters in London_
| Again, not every student from the Middle East is necessarily anti-Israel. But the reservoir of potential anti-Israel student protesters is certainly larger than before.

The rise in anti-Israel sentiment in the West clearly can’t only be about demographics. **Many, if not most, of those protesting against Israel are not those with a Middle Eastern background, but those on the political Left. **

Why then do those on the Left have such animus towards Israel? **Why do they seem to suspend ordinary moral standards whenever Israel is involved? **

When it comes to Ukraine, for example, those on the political Left – correctly in my view – see Ukraine as a brave country, rightfully taking a stand against a vastly bigger aggressor.

So why don’t they see Israel that way?

Israel wasn’t just attacked on October 7. **From the Six Day War to the Yom Kippur War, Israel has been on the receiving end of relentless aggression. **

Israel, a country smaller than Vermont, is surrounded by larger foes intent on destroying her and eradicating her people, as Hamas showed us a few months ago.
---
|
---
_Israel is smaller than Vermont_
| Progressive opinion in America and Britain is of the view that the government of Ukraine must not try to accommodate Russia or make concessions. So why do they demand that Israel call a ceasefire?

London, Washington and Berlin are full of leaders who want to supply Ukraine with weapons. Why then do many also demand that America and Europe stop giving Israel the tools to defend herself?

The last time there was unequivocal support for Israel in the West was during the Entebbe raid in Uganda in 1976. **I remember the morning of the Entebbe raid well. A young child at the time, I happened to be living close by in Kampala (pictured below).**
---
| |
---
When Israel pulled off a daring rescue mission, freeing the trapped hostages from the hijacked Air France plane at Entebbe — where Benjamin Netanyahu’s brother Yonatan lost his life — there was rejoicing across the political spectrum.
---
| **Today, when Israel attempts to rescue her hostages in Gaza she is treated by many media outlets with scorn.** Look at how posters of Israeli hostages held in Gaza have been torn down in cities throughout Europe and America.

As my friend Douglas Murray has pointed out, when a cat or dog goes missing in London or Paris or New York, people will often put up a poster about the missing pet. If we saw someone take down a poster about a missing pet, we would be offended. We’d know it was wrong. **Where is the outrage against those removing posters of the Bibas kids? **

**One reason Israel is held to a different standard is anti-Semitism. **

Anti-Semitism is a famously shape shifting virus. **At one time, Jews were hated for their religion, then for their race. Today, it seems to me, it is for their nation.**

Israel is loathed by many progressives because as a country, Israel embodies the notion of national self-determination. For many centuries, Jewish families toasted each other at Passover with the phrase: “Next year in Jerusalem.”

And then in 1948, almost miraculously, it came true.

**National self-determination offends elite opinion formers.** They revere supranationalism instead. They venerate the UN, the ICC and the EU.

Progressives prefer laws made by international treaty over those passed by elected national legislatures. Progressives prefer fealty to rules made by the global community over obligations to an actual community.

**Israel’s success offends the Left not only because she is a national state, but because she demonstrates the success of Western society. **

If all cultures were of equal worth, why then does a small state that could fit inside Vermont produce so much enterprise and innovation?

If there is an equivalence between cultures, why has post 1948 Israel seen such success amid a sea of Middle Eastern failure and autocracy?

**Those who loathe Israel don’t just hate the Jewish nation state, they despise all nation states – including another phenomenally successful Republic, started not in 1948 but in 1776. **

If they merely hate Israel, why do they burn the American flag? America and the Western way of life is their intended target.
---
|
---
_Why do anti-Israel protesters burn the US flag? _
| **Whether we like it or not, those of us who love America, who see Western culture as a sublime human achievement, have no choice but to side with and support Israel, against those who seek to destroy us all. **

Those who hate Israel hate us too.

Have a wonderful weekend!
---

---

Douglas Carswell

Dear Peter,
On July 12, at FreedomFest, I warned if we don’t end our cold civil war, the country would descend into political violence.
The next day, there was an assassination attempt on President Trump.
Thankfully, President Trump survived.
[Sadly, since the shooting, the hateful and unhinged name-calling typical of our broken, political culture has only worsened – on both sides. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_rsnd1&n=5)
Many of us want to get off this collision course. For ourselves, our neighbors and our children.
The reason why this is so critical is because the political assault on the soul of our country that keeps us divided, keeps us distracted from the monumental corruption of our system in plain sight.
In the last election, **the two parties spent over $12 billion dollars** selling off the seats of power in Washington to the highest bidder.
This peak corruption has left us with a government and an economy rigged to exploit the many and build the outsized wealth of a few.
As a result, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the 60% in the middle, our entire middle class. And hard working Americans can no longer afford life in America.
This perversion distorts and inverts our national priorities, casts aside the people’s interest and has led to decades of war, chronic disease and a devastated middle class.
[If you elect me President, I will end the forever wars and cut our wasteful defense spending in half which will still leave us with an annual defense budget that far outstrips Russia and China’s combined. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_rsnd1&n=6)

This will create millions of new jobs annually and stoke an economic boom. Our tax base will expand. We’ll pay down the debt and restore fiscal sanity.
Life in America can and will be affordable again if you help elect me President.
Over the last 40 years while party politicians have been cozying up to big money, I’ve spent those decades fighting the corporate contamination of our environment and corruption of our system.
[Send me to Washington and I will clean house.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=people_b4_politics_8_1_rsnd1&n=8)
This election is not about left vs right. It’s about all Americans of good will coming together to end the tyranny of corruption in our system so we can build back America, strong.
**We’ve given the Democrats a chance to fix this country. We’ve given Republicans a chance.** What has not had a chance is a unity government, headed by an independent President beholden to no party, free from corporate influence, owing no favors to the Washington establishment, and ready to recruit the best ideas from all those who have been left out.

Fellow Patriot,

My name is Robert Spencer. I'm an author, speaker, and expert on global Jihad and Islamic terrorism, and I wanted you to know how pro-Hamas forces are taking over higher education.

Recently, the University of California in Los Angeles (UCLA) blocked me from speaking to their students about Hamas' reign of terror through a Young America's Foundation (YAF) lecture. Instead of supporting free speech and open dialogue, UCLA administrators sided with radical leftist agitators and canceled the event.

UCLA's reason? They said that the ongoing pro-Hamas leftist supporters on the university grounds posed a safety hazard to the students who wanted to host and attend the event.

UCLA should have upheld law and order by clearing the encampments and prosecuting all violators to the fullest extent of the law.

**Instead, they took every available action to block me from speaking and to prevent their conservative students from exercising their First Amendment rights to freedom of speech and assembly. **

The organization that invited me to speak - Young America's Foundation - is suing UCLA for this blatant violation of freedom of speech.
**[Give $50 right now to fight back and help sue UCLA!](http://trk.libertyledger.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MjE2Mjk1NiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjE2LWM3YWY5OWM5MDNiYjQxZTI4NDg5NGEzNjQyZDY1Y2MzIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3NlY3VyZS55YWYub3JnL3VjbGEtbGF3c3VpdC1wcm90ZWN0LWNvbnNlcnZhdGl2ZS1zcGVlY2g_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj11Y2xhX2xhd3N1aXRfYXBwZWFsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTA1MjRfcm9iZXJ0c3BlbmNlcl9BRS1MTE81MjU2NyJ9/lz9qipmSmNmy8h_bsV4LwA)** Colleges are supposed to promote learning and dialogue, **not to provide sanctuary to radical agitators threatening Jewish students and Jihad on campus.** Yet, today, many have become sanctuaries for radical ideologies.

_All of this is having an effect on students ' opinions and attitudes today. _

Did you know that according to a recent NBC News poll, only 15% of young people ages 18-29 say their sympathies are with Israel, and nearly 1/3 of students say they sympathize with Palestinians?

In another poll, 20% of young Americans have a _positive_ view of Osama Bin Laden!

At UCLA (shortly before I was slated to deliver my speech there), pro-Hamas militants knocked a Jewish girl unconscious and stomped on her Israel flag. And there was no outrage over this by leftist administrators at the college.

Instead, a conservative coming to speak on campus is the UCLA administrators' greatest fear and the biggest security threat!

Enough is enough. We need your support to help YAF win this lawsuit against UCLA and help fight for students' free speech rights nationwide.

You may have heard of Young America's Foundation as the country's leading conservative youth organization for more than 60 years. YAF goes directly to high school and college campuses with the best speakers in the conservative movement, including **Ben Shapiro** , **Matt Walsh** , **Katie Pavlich** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , and many others so that students can freely express and engage with the values that make us free. body:
I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men.
| Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. You may have heard my name in the news. I’m an All-American swimmer -- but I’m better known for my role in the fight to save women’s sports.
Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. In the op-ed, he demanded to know if “inclusion” should be prioritized over fairness and safety when it comes to sports. But Friend, I won’t be censored! Instead, I seek to build a community of thousands of sensible Americans who know the difference between a man and a woman. I started the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute so that women would have a place to speak out against the gender ideology radicals. Please, join me and stand for women, free speech, and common sense.

body:

| | | [](http://trk.tedcruz._zZlk_4s5_UM7PotAJbA)
---
| | Fellow Conservative, We were just hit with a fundraising shockwave.
---
_" Texas Republican Senator Ted Cruz was outraised by his Democratic challenger by more than $2.5 million in the second quarter of 2024, according to newly released campaign finance filings." \- NEWSWEEK _
---
This is very serious. Folks,

My appearance on Neil Cavuto's Fox News show was an interesting one, but once I got my thoughts out, I think the American people were glad to hear somebody say the quiet part out loud.

**They see the bungled border and hell-in-a-handbasket path we're on and believe that Vice President Harris is a ding dong, plain and simple. After we've had one Vegetable in Chief for the past four years, they do not want another so-called leader who couldn't run a food truck.**

She is not a serious person. I never saw Margaret Thatcher giggling while her citizens were struggling to make ends meet.

"Momala" Harris is nothing more than an unserious San Fran Democrat who wants to have abortion-on-demand, Hamas victory "from the river to the sea," a dissolved border, criminals' rights over cops', and to replicate her "success" in Afghanistan.

At the end of the day, President Trump is going to beat Kamala Harris; the Presidential election will not be close... as long as Republicans keep their feet on the gas. The Senate, on the other hand, is another story. It's going to be too close to call.

**That's why I'm reaching out to you, my friend.** Just because the majority of the American people don't want to vote for a ding-dong, doesn't mean the Democrats don't have some tricks up their sleeves. It's imperative that we, as American Patriots, come together and support one another.

[**That said, will you join me and send my campaign a donation of at least $20 so I can help ensure we flip the Senate in November?**](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=9a474b9b55754ec1a3a70aaab77ac8f5&_e=Tn1qqtdnPgcKjEc0MlZq9IZtByb0LPZXrvYl5o7p6P8zPSe3BuIlRenDUMlXoZ23AKJv5SdHa2X-2ZnasI-pXQUfDB24YxewaKtn15WMgcbH8hSp0oFVqozGpVe9kl3ISIiKbLxYtQ-DUqskn01x8OQf3cuwTrrqFli3jWoMUJM9ieGZH-k4GRdBhqZK1faA9TcLtkUkrMJnC8oJi80U3OKm-yLg8ykTecE-A37GIxoQzmbW9rq8Pa_v8KVTN4FOTYX9-YkWWU_y3GFat9QsJinSo8NkB2TRArqPyynM6WQjGtrO_bDDXn1DwWVqNO_C6jv9UA6qlDWUlMe7-CGT0NVruAS8ed6CMwCXJ308z1xtE3BaWOA2JZLNWqphXYzIGbb9wQYvTwMbNx6o-5Zofw%3D%3D)

They see the bungled border and hell-in-a-handbasket path we're on and believe that Vice President Harris is a ding dong, plain and simple. "Momala" Harris is nothing more than an unserious San Fran Democrat who wants to have abortion-on-demand, Hamas victory "from the river to the sea," a dissolved border, criminals' rights over cops', and to replicate her "success" in Afghanistan. At the end of the day, President Trump is going to beat Kamala Harris; the Presidential election will not be close... as long as Republicans keep their feet on the gas. The Senate, on the other hand, is another story. It's going to be too close to call. That's why I'm reaching out to you, my friend. Just because the majority of the American people don't want to vote for a ding-dong, doesn't mean the Democrats don't have some tricks up their sleeves. It's imperative that we, as American Patriots, come together and support one another. clean_body: You can help me prosecute the case against Tester/Harris by endorsing my campaign today. | My opponent refuses to endorse Kamala Harris for President of the United States because he knows the Biden-Harris Administration has wrecked the U.S. economy and destroyed our borders. Jon Tester also knows that by endorsing Kamala Harris for president, he immediately loses any chance of winning reelection. But what's different now than when he recruited her to run for the Senate in 2015 and endorsed her for VP in 2020? Fellow Conservative, My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. Literally. My Democrat opponent has a lot of pressure on his back. His colleagues in the Senate, along with every left-wing news outlet in the country, are pinning their hopes of maintaining their majority on his reelection in Montana. Alarms are beginning to sound everywhere. Some news outlets are even penning articles with headlines like, "The Fate of the Senate Depends on Jon Tester. " You'd think that with all the pressure to save his party's Senate majority, he'd embrace the candidacy of the newly minted Democrat nominee for president, Kamala Harris. But in fact, he's the only Democrat in the U.S. Senate who hasn't publicly signaled his support. Here are two things that I know to be true: 1. Jon Tester won't publicy endorse Kamala Harris. 2. You have yet to endorse me in my bid to unseat the Democrat who will decide the "fate of the Senate " As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dream. With just 96 days until Election Day, we're still being outraised 3-1. I'm not sure that will ever change, but what is even more important to me and my team is knowing that we have the support of every Republican in the country as we move into the closing months of this race. . In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I ran; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign each time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. On the battlefield, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the highly trained combat warriors I served alongside as a Navy SEAL. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. And believe me, there are some tales. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why Our homeland is in danger. Radical Democrats in Washington want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream. The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. *If we fail to flip this Montana seat RED this November, we lose our best chance at a Senate Majority for the next DECADE due to the election map at play. Hey team — it’s Biz, President of the NDRC. I want to take a minute to talk to you all about Project 2025 — essentially a MAGA blueprint for how they're going to take over the government if Donald Trump is elected president. **You’ve likely seen people talking about it all over your newsfeeds and your TV screens, but there’s one part that's not getting enough attention:_the census_. ** If Project 2025 is implemented, political actors would be installed to do what government officials have always done. The constitution says once every 10 years, the government shall count every person in the country, which plays a critical role in drawing state legislative and congressional maps — and it’s always been nonpartisan actors in charge of that count. Instead, the Project 2025 agenda wants to put forward specific individual _partisan_ actors to decide who gets counted and who doesn't. **Peter, it's a pretty scary provision.** They're clearly trying to reshape the census — whether it be for map drawing and redistricting, or allocating funds from the government. The NDRC is doing everything we can to defeat the radical agenda this plan stems from, and we need your help to fight for fair maps. I want to take a minute to talk to you all about Project 2025 — essentially a MAGA blueprint for how they're going to take over the government if Donald Trump is elected president. Dear Friend,
I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can get your
free copy at this link.
In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.
This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.
This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

Click here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism."

Best regards,
Greg Stamps

Friend,

My faith has always been a core part of my values and my work in the Senate. I'm guided and motivated by the Jewish principle of "Tikkun Olam," which means to repair the world and leave it in a better place than where we found it.
It’s why I ran for office, becoming the first former synagogue president and third Jewish woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate. And it’s why I'm proudly fighting to bring positive change to communities in Nevada and across the country. **But right now, I need your help.**

Peter, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=0cd181d85f5845f181c5e629b3b34a54&_e=PNLF6va8Om4Wq5BDMQCne9ApAclEED-mFojVpXLl-QJU1k8sAtCJMUbMTO8tmR4ARKQr_a9LJWx73rAqFtwGRok8lnr5ViXADUlSl21kPDE1WGIi5uzUYVDqzFirzNANWYNg2kqi95VSlF1ZSukiL3q12jY_5GqmPkNeB8n-umR2OR8K_qV79GYM3o04DDNmd9TVQg68yjMbNUD3fHF8MsJ1rMuu4CCi01sHU6f1O-nvS7y80-FoiAgL9t15CdyMkB4W1J0HgaIwGx-TwRrd_g%3D%3D)

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=0cd181d85f5845f181c5e629b3b34a54&_e=PNLF6va8Om4Wq5BDMQCne9ApAclEED-mFojVpXLl-QJU1k8sAtCJMUbMTO8tmR4ARKQr_a9LJWx73rAqFtwGRok8lnr5ViXADUlSl21kPDE1WGIi5uzUYVDqzFirzNANXJjtdoShHxV8PmMJR7tF6GoUASpfMDhRIfBKFzgqCiAGDiCY8D-XSMNz-OQoyY8YdqLnbjVPvg85c0MqwfUyORIwDv4QA0RCGKL3z6dO95lvMyGObV4j2Abs9AN72LEIa1ls-wt2-0DGS7jpou1tRw%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.

#
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-alsobrooks-split.edwx-i&refcode=em240803-1-tt&refcode2=5363.196590._iTzpS&t=1&akid=5363%2E196590%2E_iTzpS)

A lot of folks probably don’t know this, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back.
Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families.
She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service.
I often refer to her as “ _my quintessential big sister_ ,” because she has always shown up for me when I needed her.
In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her.
I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: _More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last._
And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever.
Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent.
[**Will you please split a $25 donation right now between my campaign and The Long Run to help me defeat Republican Larry Hogan so Kamala Harris has a Democratic Senate majority on Day 1?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-alsobrooks-split.edwx-i&refcode=em240803-1-tt&t=2&akid=5363%2E196590%2E_iTzpS)

This whole election cycle boils down to this:
Will our country be dragged backwards, reverting back to an era of fear, overreach, and fewer rights?
Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a country and embrace progress?
In both Kamala Harris’ race and my own, that’s the fundamental question.
_Donald Trump IS the MAGA agenda, and Republican Larry Hogan would be another rubber stamp for it in the Senate._

In 2022, the current sheriff and his administration tried to install approximately 70 license plate readers around the county. The plan was for the license plate reader companies to then **share information with anti-choice states.** This plan could have resulted in women ending up in prison for the crime of pursuing life-saving reproductive healthcare. Thankfully, Dyer led a coalition to fight back and the current sheriff never got the chance to install his dangerous plate readers.

Dyer has already been standing up for the people of her County and deeply understands how to bring them safety, and a justice system that works for everyone. **Here’s a look at some more of Alyshia’s priorities:**

✅ **Stopping heavy-handed traffic enforcement** that has caused significant racial disparities at the Sheriff's Office. Research has shown that this practice harms Black women at higher rates than their counterparts, especially when it comes to paying fines and fees to the legal system.

✅ **Changing the demographics of the police force.** Having a mostly white and male police force has resulted in ineffective and insensitive responses to domestic violence, particularly for Black and Brown women. Officers will arrive at a domestic violence call but say they don’t see any injuries. According to Alyshia, this is often due to their lack of knowledge about the ways in which bruising and harm can show up on different skin colors. This needs to change.

✅ **Implementing in-person jail visitation.** She also wants to **ban solitary confinement for pregnant women and root out sexual harassment in jails** , which disproportionately impacts women officers and incarcerated women.

The choice is clear: Alyshia is ready to take down the administration that has been in power for 16 years and bring **_real_** and **_exciting_** change to her county. But her election is coming up in a matter of days, and she needs our help.

#
Peter — the Missouri I know is something Josh Hawley could never understand.
**Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/65301?refcode=em20240803-7248&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7248%2E614464%2EtfkZFb)

When Hawley graduated from law school, he joined one of the world’s most elite corporate law firms. I joined the Marine Corps to pay back the community in Missouri that took care of me and my family. # Principled. Experienced. Unbought.
---
---
| Greetings!
We're in the final countdown to the primaries! Hooray - we're making history together!
Thanks to YOUR help, we're by far the strongest challenger in this race. Your help has been astonishing - we've distributed over 50,000 postcards and business cards, texted over 200,000 voters, and made contact with thousands and thousands of people!
Whether you've distributed postcards, placed yard signs, shared the word on social media, or simply talked to your neighbors and family, THANK YOU.
We truly couldn't have done this without you.
As we close in on the final results - and find out whether your passionate, pro-peace, grassroots candidate will face off against a well-funded, entrenched, 28-year incumbent in November - I have another request for you.
Can you please make a short video saying why you support our campaign?
It can be 5 to 30 seconds long and doesn't have to be fancy or polished. It can be you on your phone, in the car, or at the park with your kids - just letting the world know why you support Melissa for Congress.
The most convincing thing in the world is social proof.
Sharing your story will help us reach thousands more people, who will be more open to our message after hearing your thoughts.
Can you pull out your phone and record a quick video now? Just attach it to a reply to this email. Should be fun, quick, and meaningful to you!
Thank you!!
(And, though this isn't a fundraising email, it's true that Election Day on August 6th is a major fundraising deadline for us - and if you're inclined to chip in before contribution limits re-set, please click the button below! Always deeply appreciated. We're still out-funded over 15:1!)
Wishing you, your families, and your loved ones joy, hope, and purpose \- clarity, dedication, and solidarity will help us navigate everything that we're dealing with, and all that is yet to come.
In peace, and for our real Representation, Melissa Chaudhry

Your help has been astonishing - we've distributed over 50,000 postcards and business cards, texted over 200,000 voters, and made contact with thousands and thousands of people! Whether you've distributed postcards, placed yard signs, shared the word on social media, or simply talked to your neighbors and family, THANK YOU. We truly couldn't have done this without you. As we close in on the final results - and find out whether your passionate, pro-peace, grassroots candidate will face off against a well-funded, entrenched, 28-year incumbent in November - I have another request for you. Can you please make a short video saying why you support our campaign? It can be 5 to 30 seconds long and doesn't have to be fancy or polished. It can be you on your phone, in the car, or at the park with your kids - just letting the world know why you support Melissa for Congress. The most convincing thing in the world is social proof. Sharing your story will help us reach thousands more people, who will be more open to our message after hearing your thoughts. Can you pull out your phone and record a quick video now? Just attach it to a reply to this email. Should be fun, quick, and meaningful to you! Thank you!! Wishing you, your families, and your loved ones joy, hope, and purpose \- clarity, dedication, and solidarity will help us navigate everything that we're dealing with, and all that is yet to come. subject: Join Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren to rally for Harris this Monday!
body:

| Dear |FNAME|,
In November, we have an opportunity to not only defeat fascism but also elect someone who will fight for an America where _everyone_ has a roof over their head, a good job, retirement security, great healthcare, clean air and water, and a livable future.
That’s why progressives across the country are coming together to help elect Vice President Kamala Harris! And this [**Monday, August 5th at 8pm ET you’re invited to join a Progressives for Harris kickoff call**](https://x.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=49ed250d42fe0053b97c76956&id=20f741b43e&e=4ee9085fb5) headlined by an amazing group of social, economic, racial, and climate justice champions. I mean, seriously, check out this lineup!
* Senator Bernie Sanders
* Senator Elizabeth Warren
* Senator Ed Markey
* Congressional Progressive Caucus Chairwoman Pramila Jayapal
* UAW President Shawn Fain
* Congressman Jamie Raskin
* Congresswoman Becca Balint
* Congressman Ro Khanna
* Congressman Joaquin Castro
* Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison
* NYC Comptroller Brad Lander
* Working Families Party Director Maurice Mitchell
* And dozens of other organizers and leaders of our movement!

Join these incredible leaders to learn how progressives can take action to win this critical election.
[**Click here to RSVP to Monday’s call!**](https://x.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=49ed250d42fe0053b97c76956&id=2009d83365&e=4ee9085fb5)
When the entire progressive movement is united, we are a powerful force. That may be why last night, right after we announced that Progressives for Harris will be headlined by both Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren, our Twitter account got suspended with no explanation or warning.
---
[](https://x.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=49ed250d42fe0053b97c76956&id=c1c1ba27b5&e=4ee9085fb5)
| Elon Musk and his weirdo MAGA pals are terrified of Democrats' momentum and are casting around for any tricks to slow us down. But whatever they throw at us, we're going to keep organizing, and we **will** defeat them in November.
I hope you can join us Monday! Let’s win this thing.
Sincerely,
Aaron Regunberg
P.S. I’m sending this message out to my old email list because I think coming together to win this election is so important. I won’t be sending any more emails after this, so if you’d like to stay in touch with Progressives for Harris, [**please sign up here**](https://x.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=49ed250d42fe0053b97c76956&id=5ab9a88293&e=4ee9085fb5).

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=518ef0ab81e04ff68070ede2c630b875&_e=Q31IlJbyiLbBMr-ionrgjRQnOueafhlbhDt5fxaVbNySsJA89D92m_JoF8FM6PIaorvjEy5rrDpBkXiHDaDhHl2RtSw_KU1i46vZKMT0nMnq4E5VdNTuqOROFt7xsya2wbcoJ44g0m38nVQhJCd6VP51RAelbyBUDU8fI18P-R3WMzuMM9-UVxPyUkXhnrtzy_SrmCVKgultE1lYmakPdrRyXIkPgD7J-nA9ZwZch7-jXHp5OGxrct37JT74iMStFf8roRdrlSn_8cla9Brvq27jsTVDqmIpx4rPHsaGYylc5zNZYp-HVfAYVMn4ZnoI07Rr93cvv2nLkGSs9k5azC6rymFJ2EVPGt_OmXijS8TzNIaZDX-oCVgZRs1A-afAscs2_JW8XCR5L9b7RDA0F_p-YfaXcQAoBJ6tp1nwdDs%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=518ef0ab81e04ff68070ede2c630b875&_e=Q31IlJbyiLbBMr-ionrgjRQnOueafhlbhDt5fxaVbNySsJA89D92m_JoF8FM6PIaorvjEy5rrDpBkXiHDaDhHl2RtSw_KU1i46vZKMT0nMnq4E5VdNTuqOROFt7xsya2wbcoJ44g0m38nVQhJCd6VP51RAelbyBUDU8fI18P-R3WMzuMM9-UVxPyUkXhnrtzy_SrmCVKgultE1lYmakPdrRyXIkPgD7J-nA9ZwZch7-jXHp5OGxrct37JT74iMStFf8roRdrlSn_8cla9Brvq78PiFAEPMyRaUaNNenbyNR77YCXqrMs_VMwKbz-t_01Gw4ay5ukmN1CpMoGTLSr6NvUl5edp2BVKhrtEK0QLdYF_zO6bjlB1mgmnU3IuyFJvydgI_-JG1BuoOekpYm-7ASRrAFQxKyTdyMIaOhyhsw%3D)**

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=518ef0ab81e04ff68070ede2c630b875&_e=Q31IlJbyiLbBMr-ionrgjRQnOueafhlbhDt5fxaVbNySsJA89D92m_JoF8FM6PIaorvjEy5rrDpBkXiHDaDhHl2RtSw_KU1i46vZKMT0nMnq4E5VdNTuqOROFt7xsya2wbcoJ44g0m38nVQhJCd6VP51RAelbyBUDU8fI18P-R3WMzuMM9-UVxPyUkXhnrtzy_SrmCVKgultE1lYmakPdrRyXIkPgD7J-nA9ZwZch7-jXHp5OGxrct37JT74iMStFf8roRdrlSn_8cla9Brvq_56VW-Z67nXuREPVUFxh7v3EgtE95X3XU1GS3yygES5MrtxLg7q9fsaylY7YkAYCzObEKb6br60OiWltr7Hq7oHL1pLkDW0xxNzYErG4QPnKIbO9ZDGLnklH0fj4wTiTk3fK59XhsVCFtuz1Pjjhp4%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

name: Cori Bush
subject: I turned my hurt into action
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

At 17, I was assaulted and then had an abortion. It was devastating.

I was devastated again 30 years later when Republican extremists
overturned Roe v. Wade.

But I’ve turned my hurt into action: defending access to abortion care,
organizing to expand the Supreme Court, and working with President Biden
to protect abortion rights. For me, the fight for our reproductive
freedoms is personal – and urgent.

I recently released a campaign ad that tells my story and underscores my
unwavering commitment to defend our rights at every level – especially
given the far-right’s relentless attacks on our reproductive freedoms.
Take a look here:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240803-1-cb.nwcW5U&refcode=em20240803-35870&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35870%2E1203867%2EiTocbY ]Cori Bush after Roe v. Wade was overturned: "I'm going to fight it!"

In 2022, Missouri became the first state to enact its extreme abortion ban
after the far-right Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe. More than
ever, we need a reproductive champion who will stand firm and fight back.

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=30948e44c5d646f0b208280e524d00b6&_e=m_VO4KI_RFjt9pVCGpRSMGdGwbAL1Kos-hPsOzCIRUyhxkaNeyUS0WfjNR4DqXl17j_Fx-4Sgh8zkYKZ7ODEB69XpY2oH0liTNtnImM6vP_aJhTekM1VAarwxxaI5VQSqFpDiHfVt-IsosKDuH_KdH2H_sp6tftIZce6opfahER29jxUMTJp93qNWU8snIu0O8YLTzb-ORuN_k9Md_5FBsBtRMq_JmnSn1f_1zUOtPaJQJRod6MS3qHVvN-HHFDbIhsSZBEH3aew9Nkm0NAmxy4YWaBdqbIEZEpBxm4fX8tDPYIPFLJFT-A9OkEJkz0E)_

| Peter,

With the primary in just THREE days, we wanted to share three things you should know about this race.
1. Callie is the only candidate in this race born and raised here and understands what makes Northern & Upper Michigan special. _She’s experienced firsthand the challenges our families face,_ from lack of accessible childcare to inadequate support for veterans to the struggle to find healthcare and mental healthcare services.

2. **Polling shows that once voters hear Callie's message, the race between her and Jack Bergman becomes a statistical tie** – meaning Callie has the clearest path to victory and is the candidate best suited to defeat Rep. Bergman in November.

* * *
Dear Peter, This is a longer email, but it’s important I share the story of my sister, Olivia. Being Olivia’s big sister taught me so much and shaped the person I am today. Olivia was born with microcephaly, which meant her head and brain were smaller than expected. From birth, she required complex medical care, surgeries, and equipment — wheelchairs, feeding pumps, and a nebulizer. While my dad’s union job provided some coverage, it fell short of covering everything Olivia required. **But our family was able to give Olivia everything she needed thanks to Medicaid.** Medicaid covered Olivia’s equipment, our appointments at Mary Bridge and Tacoma General Hospital, and home visits for early intervention specialists, nurses, and therapists. When the Washington legislature expanded Medicaid funding in 1993,**I learned that state lawmakers can have a life-changing impact!** Being Olivia’s big sister changed my life. At a young age, I became a caregiver: Changing diapers, hooking up Olivia’s feeding tube, making sure she got her medication, and holding her hand when she had seizures. **At school, I heard insults, cruel jokes, and the R slur — and I began my lifetime opposition to bullies in all their forms.** Olivia passed away in 2012, and I carry her memory with me every day. Our experience motivates me to fix our broken healthcare system, advocate for caregivers and disabled folks, and combat discrimination in all its forms. **Olivia’s life, marked by both profound challenges and incredible love, has shaped my vision for what healthcare in our country should be — universal, compassionate, and inclusive. ** Recently, a group of House Republicans proposed a budget that would slash $4.5 trillion — _trillion with a T_ — from Medicaid, children’s health insurance, and the Affordable Care Act. The web of care that helped our family and millions of others would be shredded. _**[I’m running for Congress to stand up to those bullies — and to bring my sister’s story, and the stories of my parents, my brother, my grandparents, and my community into the halls of power. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90149240/489567127/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmM3YjY2ZC1iMTUxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=70LyAZv-fS1v19llBvhFDCDeyvfjIag6-ZCidaXd8aM=&emci=e30c831d-5751-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=a2c7b66d-b151-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=19445147)

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90149262/489567156/1610638071?refcode=em20240803mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=a2c7b66d-b151-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmM3YjY2ZC1iMTUxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=70LyAZv-fS1v19llBvhFDCDeyvfjIag6-ZCidaXd8aM=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**

INSIDER NEWS FROM THE FRONTLINES OF THE POLITICAL REVOLUTION

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Harris vs Trump Survey Results | Time to Vote in 6 States!
| Meet our Progressive Slates | Bernie on the Ballot | Major Party Reforms
Victory! | DNC Kickoff with Rev. Jesse Jackson | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

Right-wing billionaires, corporate cronies, AIPAC, and MAGA donors are
pouring millions into Democratic primaries trying to unseat some of our
top progressive champions in Congress.

We refuse to let powerful voices like Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Cori
Bush, Pramila Jayapal, and others be silenced by the donor class.

Our Revolution and the progressive movement are mobilizing to out-organize
Big Money. This means speaking directly to voters through phone banks,
online outreach, and knocking on doors.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19115?t=1011&akid=6500%2E5885482%2ErWBiM5 ]DONATE TO HELP US DEFEND AND EXPAND PROGRESSIVE POWER IN 2024

★ ★ ★

Following President Biden’s debate, Our Revolution surveyed over 35,000 of
our supporters, and we were among the first grassroots groups to sound the
alarm about Biden’s diminished chances. We polled again after Biden passed
the torch, and we’re putting your input into action.

That’s why we’re urging VP Kamala Harris to commit to a strong,
progressive economic agenda — which 73% of you tell us is key to helping
ensure a defeat of Trump in the swing states and beyond this November.

Nearly 1 in 3 progressives are uncertain about Harris’ prospects to beat
Trump, and say the best way for Dems to win is to tackle the economic
struggles of working-class Americans. Harris is clear on the fight to save
democracy and protect women’s reproductive rights, but our members want
Harris to expand the base and campaign on kitchen table issues to win in
swing states. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19107?t=1012&akid=6500%2E5885482%2ErWBiM5 ]Read more about our survey results here.

Top priorities include campaign finance reform and standing up to
corporate power, climate action (end fossil fuel subsidies, lower energy
costs and create jobs), health care (end medical debt and expand Medicare
- dental, hearing and vision), a permanent ceasefire in Gaza (and redirect
military spending), affordable housing (plus a 5% cap on rent prices),
raising the minimum wage, growing unions, and universal childcare.

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

This month marks 8 years since Bernie founded Our Revolution and sparked a
movement that has advanced the progressive agenda at every level of
government and elected 1,000+ progressives across the country!

Right now, AIPAC and rightwing mega-donors are targeting some of our top
progressive allies in Congress, and we have great opportunities to expand
on Our Revolution’s mission to build down-ballot progressive power.

Check out our powerhouse progressive slates below — and [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19115?t=1013&akid=6500%2E5885482%2ErWBiM5 ]please donate
any amount to make sure we max out our GOTV work to elect progressives in
each of these states!

★ ★ ★

Tuesday is the last day to vote in Missouri for US Rep. Cori Bush and Our
Revolution’s amazing slate of progressives from Governor to the State
House and St. Louis Committee.

We’ve been proud to help build a progressive governing majority in St.
Louis with Our Revolution Board Member Megan Green leading the Board of
Aldermen. Local leaders and organizers have worked to deliver real change
— from taking on big developers to growing labor power.

Now, we’ve got to protect and expand the gains we’ve made — and that
starts with re-electing one of our most formidable partners in Congress —
Cori Bush.

“If we want a brighter future for our country and our world, we need to
make change that people can feel,” Cori told us. “We build power by
getting more of us in there who are willing to put our minds, our bodies
and our reputations on the line to deliver equity and justice for our
communities.”

In addition to supporting Cori, we’re organizing to elect a progressive
Governor in MO! Crystal Quade has led in the State House to restore our
abortion rights, stand up to corporate special interests, and stop China
and Russia from buying up farmland and squeezing out local farmers.

Ben Murray, Bill Stephens, and Marty Murray are all running for State
House to make a difference on gun reform, the environment, worker rights,
LGBTQ+ and racial justice, and much more — including fixing the broken
Missouri Legislature with direct democracy initiatives.

As St. Louis Sheriff, Alfred Montgomery will build a community that
thrives on trust, transparency, and unity. He will bring his focus on
youth and anti-poverty initiatives, and has plans for restorative justice
and jobs programs for exited offenders.

And, Mike Gras is running for St. Louis Committeeman in Ward 9 to be a
champion for democracy, housing, reproductive rights, and top notch
education for every child in the city.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19109?t=1014&akid=6500%2E5885482%2ErWBiM5 ]READ MORE ABOUT OUR MISSOURI SLATE HERE

★ ★ ★

We have an amazing slate of progressives in Vermont for the State House
and Senate, Lt. Governor, and of course, U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders! Last
day to vote is Aug. 13.

We have a chance to send VT Rep. Tanya Vyhovsky to the State Senate to
continue her work for climate justice, affordable housing, living wages,
social justice, universal healthcare, and fair taxation.

And, let’s re-elect Lt. Gov. David Zuckerman and VT Reps. Emilie Krasnow,
Brian Cina, and Emilie Kornheiser — who recently passed an historic law in
Vermont, forcing fossil fuel corporations to pay for the climate damage
they cause.

| | Fellow American, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=b6fed3aa30744c098c1064bc0d3d54d3&_e=jAyDQ6oQ45nKrxPQgZQivWSFRXBgzd7VDi6Z2TAu2wGGOJR18z2oHR8HuQmQyGKaRvXc7AKnWJtTaRK9EKeWX-2y_K35hMnfJRUGT3VBXbb7pTHjhkR1HoGidjv2G7s5_kuRNJacrte0-p8uWWqBi1OUha5nXaLbExZZT6xqnKhdZh9RzMfP3XK9uqBIOVjlDqfEIPTLgFlHNQi4b8rioM8sotQbkZqXdPsVBs0d0MlTSJWdAbdYac-AgH6E0PC2olAhoafhRrYeQ19dVyEghMi7iB9vYK0YlanctjON9qjRaYPGbfrQ4qxp7iSzdaIVHO61FkLFTNbsO6sko9Ri5qPdB2tPx_Carq70KCJAJttYfxzB3nxr8-Z3oJDr8Uq4jz2HHYbkDwJReCP79a9gfw%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=b6fed3aa30744c098c1064bc0d3d54d3&_e=jAyDQ6oQ45nKrxPQgZQivWSFRXBgzd7VDi6Z2TAu2wGGOJR18z2oHR8HuQmQyGKaRvXc7AKnWJtTaRK9EKeWX-2y_K35hMnfJRUGT3VBXbb7pTHjhkR1HoGidjv2G7s5_kuRNJacrte0-p8uWWqBi1OUha5nXaLbExZZT6xqnKhdZh9RzMfP3XK9uqBIOVjlDqfEIPTLgFlHNQi4b8rioM8sotQbkZqXdPsVBs0d0MlTSJWdAbdYac-AgH6E0PC2_SdEnAvngrOFjNV2XXY6w2379ViRmJkPbI2KhZtex0-nDWuKkGMdoyk7dclwSkpsImFnfEC8bFMmZ-rXmkMzNIyNhpEVSButOk4C-bsIIQb7UyWYLdS7XIlMUO71pDrBH3_osJqgmybn-4UStd6hnw%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90152834/489579674/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZDk4MzRmYy1iNzUxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q9vPryKLunzENR3a-SzRTvkha6Ll7zJsG753YjcrmZ0=) What a way to close out July. I need to say thank you. We have seen an amazing surge in grassroots support in the last two weeks, and that enabled us to hit our July fundraising goal after it looked at one point like we might not even come within sight of it. **I could not be more grateful for all the support — and the truth is, we need every bit of it if we’re going to win this race.** There’s so much hope and optimism and excitement right now. And that’s a great thing. We want to unite folks around a hopeful vision for the future. I’ve never been a believer that politics should be all about stopping your opponents — ultimately, it’s about bringing people together and getting things done. It’s about creating a better future, filled with freedom and opportunity for everyone in our community. **But let’s be clear-eyed about this: we still have a long way to go to win. We need to put in the work to sustain this momentum — because we expect this race to be decided by a tiny margin. And one extremist super PAC after another is lining up to try to swing the race in their direction.** So, yes, a lot of hard work is still in front of us. A lot of attacks, a lot of long days, and long nights. And, to be completely honest with you, a lot of emails from my team and me asking for donations. For now,_thank you_ for being a part of this grassroots team, and for everything you’re doing to help us win in November. I wouldn’t be here without your support, and that’s something I will never take for granted. And together, we’re going to win. -Sharice
