| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=cdbfef893ad34c4789df915912615037&_e=jqd3mGW_fyukBa5BB6GmmIhJu7kCK4t2HFA6X9noLD08mzNiwSG4Ey58C3l-_VZKKHx0MqkzSxeNS_YyICY1zUytqfzXu_TeaaetZo8ODWW3L7I4jPkTQdUGcw83V7011klEHDKGeIAsgXIQHJpvfFqeVWZst74J7aK4xXDtyBwtAR_yjtackVgUsDwhi4kArM9naDz3SNgnyFojKT_eM6wMoK-unKyzBpxZhdZPCAySmmRBffr87wsrUCfvGaRZ8AYmE6n8B04Tm4H3Xc-UbmQEPXaJWf9t6ijM1H5QDv5FVNpeVtSP9q7n_GOiw0TtBNMA2D_ngx2JXwWkahEQFxeEGC8PGj-Y56cbCaQj7Ro_bhjCBN9cgrHBSaOOQGU1kox5zHSqS34aFBmOVaOU83XEdfDrLObeE6tDHkCqX0A%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=cdbfef893ad34c4789df915912615037&_e=jqd3mGW_fyukBa5BB6GmmIhJu7kCK4t2HFA6X9noLD08mzNiwSG4Ey58C3l-_VZKKHx0MqkzSxeNS_YyICY1zUytqfzXu_TeaaetZo8ODWW3L7I4jPkTQdUGcw83V7011klEHDKGeIAsgXIQHJpvfFqeVWZst74J7aK4xXDtyBwtAR_yjtackVgUsDwhi4kArM9naDz3SNgnyFojKT_eM6wMoK-unKyzBpxZhdZPCAySmmRBffr87wsrUCfvGaRZ8AYmE6n8B04Tm4H3Xc-UbhpYIQ_0h5KtIAgH_2WBiXNhwIjSQLCU-BOUGcFGICttpIr7Os9Q8HTcFyQcgf4cY1Bic9u2vOEIGMc_7FgkVineh5_jntBWDWTxU_ZHWMod1Y9FL-ica_kr8XzAdsE2qWxVqi3cFi4i4XyU-qEcdM8%3D)**

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

body:
Derek,

**Pennsylvania is _the_ tipping point in 2024** – for the Senate, the White House, and the direction our Nation will go.

That means what we do here in Pennsylvania has a MAJOR impact. Between our Commonwealth’s tipping point status in the Electoral College and our own critical Senate race, we can expect unprecedented amounts of money to be spent here. Outside interest groups have already started spending their planned $75 million in advertising to blanket the airwaves.

We have to do everything we can to help Bob win and keep PA blue — and to build that kind of robust campaign, we need you. [**Will you split any amount between Bob and Chris Deluzio right now to help power Bob Casey to re-election?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90153626/489582857/-1384849265?refcode=email_080324_caseysplit&amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjQyNzRjZi1iOTUxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3wLo8S1_gfIJQ-wHg4l1rAFbGtxn437tn9jvYHcycQI=)

| | Hi Peter, I’ve had many different jobs, and I’ve spent much of my career working to protect the environment. But looking back, one stands out as a favorite. Before I ran for Congress, before I served in the Arizona legislature, before I taught at the U of A (Go Cats!), before I worked as an environmental lawyer cleaning up contaminated waste sites and holding corporate polluters accountable — I worked as a National Park Ranger.

Our national parks are essential sanctuaries for local wildlife and ecosystems. They preserve some of the country's most beautiful places. Some news outlets are even penning articles with headlines like, "The Fate of the Senate Depends on Jon Tester." | My opponent refuses to endorse Kamala Harris for President of the United States because he knows the Biden-Harris Administration has wrecked the U.S. economy and destroyed our borders. Jon Tester also knows that by endorsing Kamala Harris for president, he immediately loses any chance of winning reelection. But what's different now than when he recruited her to run for the Senate in 2015 and endorsed her for VP in 2020? Fellow Conservative, My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. Literally. My Democrat opponent has a lot of pressure on his back. His colleagues in the Senate, along with every left-wing news outlet in the country, are pinning their hopes of maintaining their majority on his reelection in Montana. Alarms are beginning to sound everywhere. Some news outlets are even penning articles with headlines like, "The Fate of the Senate Depends on Jon Tester. " You'd think that with all the pressure to save his party's Senate majority, he'd embrace the candidacy of the newly minted Democrat nominee for president, Kamala Harris. But in fact, he's the only Democrat in the U.S. Senate who hasn't publicly signaled his support. Here are two things that I know to be true: 1. Jon Tester won't publicy endorse Kamala Harris. 2. You have yet to endorse me in my bid to unseat the Democrat who will decide the "fate of the Senate " As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dream. With just 96 days until Election Day, we're still being outraised 3-1. I'm not sure that will ever change, but what is even more important to me and my team is knowing that we have the support of every Republican in the country as we move into the closing months of this race. . In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I ran; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign each time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. On the battlefield, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. subject: My father was deported back to our home country when I was 19
body:
I always had to jump through extra hoops compared to my peers. | | | Peter — While most 19-year-old girls are starting college or enjoying life, my experience was very different. **At 19, my father was deported back to our home country.** From that moment, I've faced an overwhelming sense of loneliness and a lack of support. _I grew up without my grandparents, and now my son is growing up without his grandfather._ Now that I’m a mother, the risks of losing DACA loom even larger. If I lose my protections, I could be deported just like my father. If that were to happen, I don’t know what I would do. Leave my son? Or take him away from everything he knows and start a new life? In this upcoming 2024 election, there’s so much at stake for undocumented people, especially in Texas. The Texas legislature continues to push and pass bills like SB4 that hinder undocumented communities. We can't even take our family members to the grocery store or a doctor's appointment without fearing detention and deportation — this truly paralyzes our community and it can cost us our lives. We need to work together to remove racists and bigots from the state legislature and elect leaders who will uplift undocumented individuals. These future leaders should ensure that undocumented people can thrive and continue to contribute to our state with the secure status they deserve. **[United We Dream Action is fighting for a clear path to citizenship and supporting pro-immigrant candidates in Texas and nationwide. | Friends,
Great news! Our momentum is growing faster than ever, and we have Susan Wild on the ropes.
This week it was reported that I was added to the NRCC “Young Guns” program. This important designation comes with important funding for the campaign and helps us get the word out across the nation about just how important this race is!
That news follows on the heels of new polling showing a statistical tie in this race. Considering that we’re running against an entrenched incumbent with millions of dollars from special interests and far-left groups, this is BIG NEWS! With your help, we can take the lead in this race and finally flip the Lehigh Valley **RED.**
**Here is what I was up to this week:**
* Veterans For Mackenzie Roundtable
* Meeting Neighbors
* Nazareth Community Days
* 100 Days to Go!

As always, if you need to contact the campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.
All the Best,
Ryan Mackenzie
---
|
---
| **Veterans For Mackenzie Roundtable**
This past week, we hosted a Veterans for Mackenzie roundtable event. Roughly 30 veterans came to talk to me about their concerns and how I could address them in Washington D.C.
One thing is clear: Susan Wild is letting our veterans down. Not only did she vote against veterans and support illegal immigrants instead, but she has disparaged veterans right here in the Lehigh Valley. Read about that [here](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=31f94c8ced&e=5ccada9200).
These veterans also expressed their frustration with the shoddy treatment they’ve received from legislative staffers. I’ll make sure that those who served our country are treated with the respect they deserve from my office if I’m fortunate enough to represent them.
Thank you to all the veterans who came out!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| **Meeting Neighbors**
This week I had a terrific meet and greet in Allentown with neighbors who are tired of the mess caused by Washington D.C. elites and insiders. If you are interested in hosting a meet and greet, please email us at [Info@mackenzieforcongress.com](mailto:Info@mackenzieforcongress.com)
---
|
---
| **Nazareth Community Days**
My team and I had a blast at the Nazareth Community Days. It’s a pleasure to talk with the voters and hear about the change that they want to see in Washington.
---
|
---
| **100 Days to Go!**
Over the weekend, we broke 100 days remaining before election day on November 5th. I spent the weekend launching my door-to-door teams and talking to voters in Plainfield Township, Williams Township, and the Puerto Rican Day Parade in Allentown.

Hi team,
This week, the Senate voted to pass the Kids Online Safety Act (KOSA). This is the first bill to significantly protect children online since the invention of the Internet.
It would require social media companies to take reasonable steps to prevent harms like bullying, drug addiction, and sexual exploitation. It would limit the use of design features, like endless scroll and autoplay. And it would set out new privacy requirements for our kids.
Our kids’ mental health is suffering, and addictive social media platforms are making it worse. KOSA is the first step in addressing this crisis.
I’m committed to protecting our kids online and tackling our youth mental health crisis in this country. I won’t stop until I see it done, but I could use your help.
KOSA has passed the Senate, but now we need the House to do the same. Join me in calling on Speaker Mike Johnson to bring KOSA to a vote, hold Big Tech accountable, and protect our children >> [https://secure.michaelbennet.com/a/x_080324_kosapetition]

Donald Trump leveled his most direct attacks against Ruben. He called him a radical, an extremist. He railed against Ruben and rallied all of his supporters behind Kari Lake.
#

Peter - on the night before our primary, Donald Trump leveled his most direct attacks against Ruben.
He called him a radical, an extremist. He railed against Ruben and rallied all of his supporters behind Kari Lake.
Bad news, but what does that mean for our campaign?
**It means a fundraising surge for Kari Lake** — small dollar donations from the millions of MAGA-right supporters Trump and Kari Lake have at their beck and call.
**It means more grassroots support** — volunteers and activists listening to Trump and getting behind Kari Lake to swing momentum for her in Arizona and around the country.

So, today, as we take our first steps into the General Election, we’re asking you for your help.
We have to match their energy with our own. If they get the edge they could swamp us.

Ohio Capitol Journal: Ohio’s voter purge “disproportionately targets voters of color”, civil rights organizations say [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080324_2&amount=25]
Ohio is removing nearly 160,000 voters from the rolls, Team.
More than half of Ohio voters who might be purged from the state’s voter rolls are registered in counties where a majority of the population is non-white. Civil rights organizations on the ground say that Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose’s voter purge disproportionately goes after those voters of color.
This is yet another example of partisan elected officials using state law to suppress voters who don't vote for them or their party. The easiest way to secure the results they want is to pick and choose which voters get to count in November.
We must fight voter purges like this in Ohio and elsewhere across the country. Chip in $25 or whatever you can to end this suppressive practice and make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=080324_2&amount=25]

Perhaps the biggest irony of Algerian Olympian Imane Khelif's Olympic boxing run is that while today she suffers misogyny for being not 'female enough,' she grew up facing opposition that as a girl, [boxing was 'too manly.'](https://substack.com/redirect/fed342e4-eaae-4cf1-8ebb-42f78d3deffa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The 2024 Paris Olympic Games were supposed to be the "[Gender Equal Olympics](https://substack.com/redirect/95afb3b1-199b-41db-b73a-1a0dd3076457?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." To advance the Olympic [mission](https://substack.com/redirect/a2fd10b6-1f67-40ec-934a-e5cdfe4a89a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "_to promote safe sport and the protection of athletes from all forms of harassment and abuse_." Instead, we see repeated examples of horrid Islamophobia and misogyny. French Muslim women are [banned from wearing Hijab.](https://substack.com/redirect/592d4527-8f14-4313-b362-1fd82da5c849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Palestinian women suffer genocide as their oppressors compete [despite IOC rules banning nations from competing while violating international law](https://substack.com/redirect/927b9232-4570-4600-81ea-667977468ae1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And in the latest debacle, an Algerian Muslim woman, Imane Khelif, is demonized as not a real woman.
What has led us to this shameful situation, and how do we ensure justice for female athletes and Muslim athletes going forward? **Let 's Address This**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ae58f15-639c-4675-bf07-795f04d5cce4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Italy's Angela Carini (left) ended her match with Algeria's Imane Khelif (right) on Thursday after 46 seconds. Photo Credit: AP
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=147312780&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ3MzEyNzgwLCJpYXQiOjE3MjI3MTE2NzcsImV4cCI6MTcyNTMwMzY3NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.E9T57uBcLB7VjaGjB0YHcrpGRXTketALlLo87J8pM4w)
The latest bout of Islamophobia and misogyny comes from global ire directed at Imane Khelif, the sensational Algerian boxer competing in her second Olympic games. Khelif faced Italian boxer Angela Carini in the round of 16. After getting punched in the face for a second time, Carini forfeited the bout, granting Khelif the victory. In a tearful display Carini quit, igniting global compassion for her, and demonization for Khelif.
VP Presidential candidate JD Vance [tweeted](https://substack.com/redirect/82b38c34-fdc7-4aec-9f2b-35bd570c9515?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> This is where Kamala Harris's ideas about gender lead: to a grown man pummeling a woman in a boxing match. This is disgusting, and all of our leaders should condemn it.
Author JK Rowling [added](https://substack.com/redirect/061c9041-56bf-47a7-8b89-9d5c4554d65f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The idea that those objecting to a male punching a female in the name of sport are objecting because they believe Khelif to be 'trans' is a joke. We object because we saw a male punching a female.
Swimmer Riley Gaines tweeted a picture of Carini with the [caption](https://substack.com/redirect/7c0ce627-5864-42c4-b037-46087ce0e892?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Men don't belong in women's sports [#IStandWithAngelaCarini](https://substack.com/redirect/c0cccfb7-8b60-4c3c-91ea-122e1ac2e7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Let's get it trending.
To which Twitter owner Elon Musk quote [tweeted](https://substack.com/redirect/6ca902e2-0b11-4829-bca6-c9bdb1083180?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Absolutely.
There's only one problem with all of the above--Imane Khelif is not a man, she is a woman. [Khelif was born a woman, is a woman, and has always identified as a woman](https://substack.com/redirect/0f863a9d-efb6-4b7d-9e8c-50f96033146c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Yet the weaponization of white women tears from Italian boxer Angela Carini, combined with anti-LGBTQ misinformation and violence, changed all that in a mere 46 seconds. And in addition to the above right wing provocateurs, legacy media added to the misinformation campaign, labeling Khelif a "transgender boxer." The Boston Globe issued this headline well after it was explicitly clear that Khelif is not transgender and has never been transgender. This is yet another example of legacy media's abject failure to protect the marginalized and hold the powerful accountable.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ea7f6c25-af2b-40a5-a271-e13814d4070e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In fact, Angela Carini tears were so powerful that the International Boxing Association announced that they will award her $50K in prize money, which is the equivalent of what an Olympic gold medalist receives, for dropping out of her bout against Imane Khelif. "_[I couldn't look at her tears](https://substack.com/redirect/e95779ac-6007-4c4e-9d3d-638a13c2c12f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ ," IBA President Umar Kremlev said in a press release. For as much as conservatives despise participation trophies, they sure are proud of Carini's.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b135f4bd-e5f4-4c17-b96f-df1fdcc7833b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Algerian boxer Imane Khelif, as an Olympian and as a little girl.
If there is one thing the Olympics have taught us, is there's no one 'right' body size or shape for any athlete. The viral clip by [star Rugby player Ilona Maher beautifully demonstrates that](https://substack.com/redirect/8772ca01-8ba1-48c0-9d60-e7ca411559d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Yet, the global piling on of an Algerian Muslim woman because she doesn't 'look' female enough is indicative of what I've long said--Islamophobia is one of the last acceptable forms of bigotry in the world. Adding to the absurdity of this misinformation is that Khelif competed in the 2021 Olympics without issue. Fellow female boxers like world champion Amy Broadhurst [tweeted](https://substack.com/redirect/d0a0127f-439f-4691-a568-f08c931d0174?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Have a lot of people texting me over Imane Khelif. Personally I don't think she has done anything to 'cheat'. I thinks it's the way she was born & that's out of her control. The fact that she has been beating by 9 females before says it all.
One of those 9 females, by the way, is Amy Broadhurst. Thus, my question is simple--in the face of all this misogyny and Islamophobia, where is the IOC? The Olympic mission also calls "_to act against any form of discrimination affecting the Olympic Movement_." Unfortunately, for Muslim women in the 2024 Olympics, none of these rules seem to apply. Throughout these Olympics we've seen grotesque discrimination against women and Muslim athletes, and yet the IOC either stands by, or further enables it.
For the Olympics to ever truly live up to their proposed mission, the world's 1.6B Muslims, and the world's 4B women, must receive the same respect and dignity as all people. Imane Khelif, French Muslim women, and Palestinian women are already combatting the world's greatest athletes in their quests for gold--the least the IOC can do is protect them from the world's greatest bigots.

I thinks it's the way she was born & that's out of her control. The fact that she has been beating by 9 females before says it all. One of those 9 females, by the way, is Amy Broadhurst. Thus, my question is simple--in the face of all this misogyny and Islamophobia, where is the IOC? Throughout these Olympics we've seen grotesque discrimination against women and Muslim athletes, and yet the IOC either stands by, or further enables it. For the Olympics to ever truly live up to their proposed mission, the world's 1.6B Muslims, and the world's 4B women, must receive the same respect and dignity as all people. Imane Khelif, French Muslim women, and Palestinian women are already combatting the world's greatest athletes in their quests for gold--the least the IOC can do is protect them from the world's greatest bigots. body:
Wherever I go, people ask me what it’s going to take to hold the Senate or flip the House this year.
#

Hey team, it's Mark.
I’ve spent a lot of time over the last year traveling the country to support friends in tough races. Wherever I go, people ask me what it’s going to take to hold the Senate or flip the House this year.
It’s a good question. Our margins are extremely thin, and we’re on defense in far too many races.
But I know a thing or two about winning tough races, having been in two myself.
Ultimately, what it’s going to take is all of us doing whatever we can to make sure these competitive campaigns have the resources they need to win.
That’s why I’m writing to you today. We’re doing a ton of work to support pro-democracy candidates around the country, whether it’s supporting their campaigns or building infrastructure. The fight to defend our democracy and stop extremism from taking root in Congress has a frontline, and I’m on it.

clean_body: Spoiler: They don’t have much in common. | = Donald Trump and J.D. Vance FACT #1: J.D. Vance is a major recipient of oil and gas money. As a shareholder in these companies, Vance profits personally when oil and gas thrive. His commitment to fracking and dismissal of climate change as a non-threat make his priorities clear. FACT #2: Donald Trump promises to “Drill, baby, drill” and vowed to shut down funding for a transition to green energy, labeling it “a Green New scam.” His vision is part of the broader and more alarming Project 2025 agenda, which aims to dismantle the Environmental Protection Agency, roll back restrictions on oil drilling, and let Republican state officials (many of whom are in the pocket of Big Oil) take over environmental regulation. FACT #3: During his presidency, Trump rolled back a whopping 100+ environmental rules and policies, including loosening oversight of polluting industries and eroding Obama-era efforts to address the climate crisis. If his track record is any indication, re-electing Trump means skyrocketing emissions and increasingly devastating climate impacts. Vice President Kamala Harris FACT #1: As California's Attorney General, Kamala Harris tackled significant cases against major polluters, including initiating an investigation into Exxon Mobil for misleading the public about the dangers of the climate crisis. FACT #2: As a U.S. Senator, Harris championed the Green New Deal, advocating for carbon neutrality by 2030. She introduced legislation for clean electric school buses, reducing lead and other contaminants in drinking water, and consistently fought for environmental justice. FACT #3: As Vice President, she also cast the tie-breaking vote for the largest piece of climate legislation in U.S. history. ### **NEW WAY TO SERVE: TTV’s Long Term Care Project**

This Wednesday, True the Vote will host a short training program on how you can reach to these facilities and support registered voters (or help them register). We’ll provide you with everything you need to get started.

Can I tell you the story of how I first got involved in politics, Peter?

While serving as the president of the largest synagogue in Nevada, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.

In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.

Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country. And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**

Peter,
I am proud to be a Justice Democrat, and with your support, JD will continue to fight for a country that represents We the People, not corporate special interests.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Can I make a case for your support?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1720%2E135344%2ERrtP9K)

Friend --
In just a few days, Michigan will have its U.S. Senate primary and we will know who our opponent is for the general election.
With your permission, I’d appreciate the chance to make the case for why a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate before that happens is one of the most strategic contributions you can make today.
Let me start with what you probably already instinctively know: Michigan is going to be a critical state for the 2024 campaign.
There is no winning the White House without Michigan. For Democrats, there is no holding the Senate without Michigan. Even our House delegation rests on a one-seat Democratic majority.
But you were probably already sold on the importance of Michigan. So, aside from the fact that control of the U.S. Senate is at stake (!), what about my race? Why donate to my campaign?
This is one of the rare open Senate races without an incumbent running -- in fact, it’s one of the few competitive races in the entire country. That means we have A LOT of introducing of me to do across the state. A recent poll showed about 50% of the state knows me, across our 11 media markets.
Reaching those folks takes resources, and that's not something I can do without you.
Add the fact that this is going to be one of the most expensive races in the country -- not just with candidate spending, but outside spending too.
And I'll close with the news that in all of my elections, I have historically done better than Democrats usually do in the "redder" areas of the state. That means I am finding and pulling voters other races couldn't, and that is good for Kamala Harris and every other Democrat on the ballot on Election Day.
So yes, this race is kind of a unicorn. It's a unique situation where control of the White House and Congress is on the line, most voters don't know the candidates yet, and the Democratic Senate candidate can help the top of the ticket.
[**That's why I am asking for your support: Can I count on you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate before the Michigan primary happens and we know who our opponent will be? I would not ask if it were not so important.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240803-2-900&t=2&akid=1720%2E135344%2ERrtP9K)
